rules.reason: The Harley Group is not VAT registered. Do not claim Zero VAT, Zero-Rated VAT or +VAT in customer marketing.
14-day delivery guarantees and 24h instant reply SLAs are unverified and retired.
Unqualified guarantees are forbidden. Use 'What we commit to' instead.
Never make numerical or speculative SEO/ranking promises.
Stale pricing tiers (£95/mo, £995, £2,995) must be replaced with approved £1,495 + £249/mo.
Pilot scope is Bristol, Bath and the M4 corridor. Do not claim nationwide or entire UK.

rules.pattern: do not market|do not renew|pitch as|valuation range|retired / non-renewal
rules.reason: Internal underwriting notes, trademark cautions, and valuation floors must never be exposed to public buyers.
Use Robbie (not Robert), founder-led (no studio team), and no fake verified clients.
